name: ml-pipeline
description: Data-first ML discipline plugin: a strict 16-step pipeline with user-permission gates that stops coding agents from jumping straight to model training.

plugins.name: ml-pipeline
plugins.description: Forces any ML task through inspect → EDA → problem definition → clean → engineer → split → features → preprocess → baseline → train → tune → evaluate → error analysis → final test → deploy → monitor, with explicit permission gates and marimo/matplotlib visuals.
